payload.title: stories next and the Story card should show the stored checklist state, not only the evidence view
payload.description: papyrus stories next (newsroom_process.assess) computes each step from evidence: direction and research from an Assignment with a direction or research packet, outline and draft from versions, the four review lenses always not_done (no record proves them). The publish gate reads the STORED checklist rows (story_checklist.require_checklist_closed), so a Story whose steps were closed with stories step still shows not_done in stories next. Show the stored row state (done, skipped, not applicable, with its note and who) when one exists; keep the evidence view as a hint only. Add a CLI to print the stored checklist (stories checklist or stories show). Found 2026-11-09 by the news desk editing session.
